text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Heeeeeey!!!!
Windyyyyyy!!!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Gyaaah~!! R-Royce~~!
Save me, please~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Good grief,
could you tell her too, Royce?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Judging by that look,
it seems you've been up to mischief again.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Seems she suddenly snapped at the girls chatting in the lobby. Honestly, she pulls this kind of thing the moment she just wants some attention.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
She might just want to play...
but biting is something I cannot overlook.
Therefore, Windy-san. You areâ

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Mmh!? Are you going to punish Windy-chan too, Royce?!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ...No! Something far more effective!

"...This is troublesome. Buying notebooks in bulk was great and all,
but the packaging is pretty thick—
or rather, insanely tough...!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Wait! There's no need for that!
Leave this to the biting pro,
Windy-san!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Grr, grr!! Lemme hold it for a sec!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmph! A bag like this is a piece of cake for Windy-chan's fangs!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Windy-san, one more rep!
Clench your teeth like you're
gonna bite right through that mouthguard!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Squeeeeze...!!
Go for ittttttt!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Then let's consider the budget proposal
for the next term settled with this—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
! Now's your chance, Windy-san!
Time to bite!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
G-Grrrr!!
Wait a second! Speaking as an ordinary student—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. It seems your reputation as 'Pro Biter Windy-chan'
is steadily spreading, isn't it?
choice_data_list: Why on earth would you do something like this...?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Good question. Hishi Ama-san's request was
to stop the biting.
However... my opinion is a little different.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Being a biter is Windy-san's trademark!
In that case... she should bite more, even more!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
That way, you'll expand your persona and get even more popular!
No more biting people just to get attention!
That's my vision for producing you!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Royce! Got any more work for a pro biter!?
My teeth are itching for some action!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry! I've got plenty more plans!
Let's make sure the whole world knows just how amazing Windy-san's biting is!
choice_data_list: (She sure has a way with words... fitting, since she bites.)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Owww, ow-ow-ow-ow...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's the matter, Big Sis?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
No, I just ate a massive steak for lunch
to build up some stamina, you see.
And now my jaw's aching just a tiny bit...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph! It's Hishi Ama's fault for being reckless
when she's not even a pro biter, nanoda...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: —Please wait. This is a chance to show what a biting pro can do!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: H-Hey, Hishiama!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
When it starts hurting from biting too much...
you gotta massage the little hollows
at the base of your jaw!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Huh? The hollow part under the chin?
Which means...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Aaaagh, come on!
This is so frustrating!!!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Look, right here!!
Knead, knead! Kneeead and squiiish~~!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Waaah-tatata!?
H-Hold on, Windy!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Ooh~! Thanks to you, that feels much better!
Guess all that snapping at people year-round wasn't just for show!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Fufufu... Splendid, Windy-san! You've taken yet another step in developing your character!
choice_data_list: So it's like, bite into anything and solve it with speed?
Strength all comes down to how you use it, huh.
Strength all comes down to how you use it, you know.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Fufufu... Splendid, Windy-san! You've taken yet another step in developing your character!
choice_data_list: So it's like, bite into anything and solve it with speed?
Strength all comes down to how you use it, huh.
Strength all comes down to how you use it, you know.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Eventually, I'll become the "All-Rounder Biting Umamusume" who shines brilliantly in racing history!
Such a tagline isn't just a dream!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Nunu! Th-That kinda sounds cool...
Or maybe not really...!

...At any rate, under Royce and Royce's
production, a brand-new potential for "biting"
seemed to have been demonstrated (?)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I just hope he stops the mischief
and only bites when it's actually helpful to people.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, it's also true that there's demand for
a mischievous character. Using a prankster persona
as a base, while occasionally acting like a good girl—"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? ...Wait, no no no!
Doesn't that totally defeat the purpose?!

There are many ways to approach the 'biter' persona—
It was an event where Royce and Royce's producing skills truly shone.
